title: Jacob Rubin pitches Galaxy Digital at Sohn 2026
description: Jacob Rubin, Founder and Managing Member, Philosophy Capital Management pitches Galaxy Digital, specifically its Helios data center, as a primary opportunity at the Sohn 2026 Investment Conference, along with Nokia.
summary: The speaker pitches Galaxy Digital's Helios data center project as a unique investment opportunity characterized by significant upside potential relative to peers due to its discounted valuation and contracted revenue with CoreWeave. The argument relies on the site's specific advantages, including 1,500 contiguous acres with underground aquifer water, access to 70+ gigawatts of renewable power at a key node, and a private substation, alongside strong execution evidenced by on-time delivery of the first hall to CoreWeave.
